variant.briefing:
Some crew whose name doesn’t even deserve to cross my lips stole a bunch of our supplies, and then hid them in [Location]. As if we wouldn’t be able to track them down. Now that we know where they hid the goods it’s time to make them pay. 

Interested in raiding that cave and getting our shit back? Do your worst to whoever’s inside just don’t damage our goods. Then bring everything to  [Destination]. Sounds kinda fun. Makes me miss my days when I applied my other skills to help the gang.

Stows out.
